  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "Introduces SDMX Registry Services (a registry as a metadata index, not a data store; four registry services: maintenance of structural metadata, registration of data/metadata sources, querying, subscription/notification) and SDMX 3.0's standardization on RESTful web services with an OpenAPI specification and five resources."
  },
  "concepts": [
    {
      "id": "c_sdmx_registry_services",
      "name": "SDMX registry services",
      "aliases": ["SDMX Registry Services"],
      "description": "A set of registry services providing visibility of, and access information for, data and reference metadata in the SDMX model of statistical exchange.",
      "anchor": "SDMX registry services concern themselves",
      "location": "sdmx-3-0-section-1-framework#c0011"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_registry",
      "name": "registry",
      "aliases": ["metadata registry"],
      "description": "An application maintaining and storing metadata for querying, acting as the index of a distributed metadata repository; SDMX specifies its interfaces but not its implementation.",
      "anchor": "supported by a registry",
      "location": "sdmx-3-0-section-1-framework#c0011"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_maintenance_structural_metadata",
      "name": "Maintenance of Structural Metadata",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Registry service allowing users with maintenance agency access privileges to submit and modify structural metadata; the registry acts as a structural metadata repository.",
      "anchor": "Metadata : This registry service",
      "location": "sdmx-3-0-section-1-framework#c0011"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_registration_sources",
      "name": "Registration of Data and Metadata Sources",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Registry service allowing maintenance agencies to inform the registry of the existence and retrieval location of data sets and reference metadata sets.",
      "anchor": "Registration of Data and Metadata Sources",
      "location": "sdmx-3-0-section-1-framework#c0011"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_querying",
      "name": "Querying",
      "aliases": ["registry querying"],
      "description": "Registry interfaces for querying the metadata contained in a registry so applications and users can discover data sets, metadata sets, providers and provider agreements.",
      "anchor": "Querying: The registry",
      "location": "sdmx-3-0-section-1-framework#c0011"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_subscription_notification",
      "name": "Subscription/Notification",
      "aliases": ["subscription and notification"],
      "description": "Registry service allowing subscription to specific registry objects so that subscribers are notified when those objects are updated.",
      "anchor": "Subscription/Notification",
      "location": "sdmx-3-0-section-1-framework#c0011"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_restful_web_services",
      "name": "RESTful web services",
      "aliases": ["RESTful Web services", "REST API"],
      "description": "The web service style SDMX 3.0 standardized on, described by an OpenAPI specification with five resources.",
      "anchor": "standardized on RESTful web services",
      "location": "sdmx-3-0-section-1-framework#c0011"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_web_services",
      "name": "Web services",
      "aliases": ["web services"],
      "description": "Mechanism allowing computer applications to exchange data directly over the Internet, enabling modular or distributed computing.",

      "location": "sdmx-3-0-section-1-framework#c0011"
    },
    {
      "id": "c_structural_metadata",
      "name": "structural metadata",
      "aliases": ["structural metadata repository"],

      "anchor": "structural metadata repository",
      "location": "sdmx-3-0-section-1-framework#c0011"
    }
